zh-CN.headlineFact: 红海改道、AI进实验室；世界在平台、贸易与韧性之间重新分配成本
zh-CN.headlineView: 当速度继续上升，真正决定结果的，是基础设施、规则与韧性能否同步扩容。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 红海改道、AI进实验室；世界在平台、贸易与韧性之间重新分配成本；当速度继续上升，真正决定结果的，是基础设施、规则与韧性能否同步扩容。
zh-CN.intro: 红海油轮改道，AI进入美国国家科研基础设施；WhatsApp降低沟通摩擦。欧盟质疑JD.com收购，Nike收紧中国线上分销；知识可达性、巨杉韧性与油价通胀也在变化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当速度继续上升，真正决定结果的，是基础设施、规则与韧性能否同步扩容。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 新闻看起来各走各路，最后都在问同一件事：系统扛得住吗？

en-US.headlineFact: Tankers reroute and AI enters the lab; the world reallocates costs across platforms, trade and resilience
en-US.headlineView: As speed keeps rising, outcomes depend on whether infrastructure, rules and resilience can expand with it.
en-US.headlineFull: Tankers reroute and AI enters the lab; the world reallocates costs across platforms, trade and resilience; As speed keeps rising, outcomes depend on whether infrastructure, rules and resilience can expand with it.
en-US.intro: Tankers reroute in the Red Sea, AI enters US national research infrastructure and WhatsApp cuts communication friction. The EU questions a JD.com deal, Nike tightens China distribution, while knowledge access, sequoia resilience and oil-driven inflation are also shifting.
en-US.xiaziQuote: As speed keeps rising, outcomes depend on whether infrastructure, rules and resilience can expand with it.
en-US.doudouQuote: The stories take different roads, but ask the same question: can the system hold?

zh-CN.headlineFact: 红海再有四艘油轮改道；第二条能源通道也开始失去确定性
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球供应链最怕的不是一条路变慢，而是备用路线也同时失去确定性。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 红海再有四艘油轮改道；第二条能源通道也开始失去确定性；全球供应链最怕的不是一条路变慢，而是备用路线也同时失去确定性。
zh-CN.intro: 胡塞武装威胁沙特相关航运后，7月22日又有4艘油轮在红海改变航向，此前一天已有3艘改道。红海原本是霍尔木兹受阻后的重要替代路线，如今两处能源咽喉同时承压，绕行与保险成本可能继续上升。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 全球供应链最怕的不是一条路变慢，而是备用路线也同时失去确定性。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 以前是绕路贵一点，现在是连绕哪条路都要重新算。

en-US.headlineFact: Four more tankers reroute in the Red Sea; a second energy corridor loses certainty
en-US.headlineView: Supply chains fear not one slow route, but backup routes losing certainty at the same time.
en-US.headlineFull: Four more tankers reroute in the Red Sea; a second energy corridor loses certainty; Supply chains fear not one slow route, but backup routes losing certainty at the same time.
en-US.intro: After Houthi threats to Saudi-linked shipping, four more tankers changed course in the Red Sea on July 22, following three reroutes the day before. The route was a key alternative if Hormuz was blocked; pressure on both chokepoints could lift detour and insurance costs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Supply chains fear not one slow route, but backup routes losing certainty at the same time.
en-US.doudouQuote: It used to mean a pricier detour. Now even the detour needs recalculating.

sources.title: Rubio says US still willing to negotiate over Iran crisis

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA与OpenAI加入Genesis Mission；AI开始被当作国家科研基础设施
zh-CN.headlineView: 当AI进入国家科研体系，竞争重点会从模型演示转向数据、算力、设施与长期协作。
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA与OpenAI加入Genesis Mission；AI开始被当作国家科研基础设施；当AI进入国家科研体系，竞争重点会从模型演示转向数据、算力、设施与长期协作。
zh-CN.intro: NASA与OpenAI于7月22日分别宣布支持美国Genesis Mission。NASA称该计划已扩展至15个以上联邦机构；OpenAI将与政府、国家实验室、大学和研究人员合作，把前沿模型连接超级计算机、模拟系统与科研设施，加速科学发现。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当AI进入国家科研体系，竞争重点会从模型演示转向数据、算力、设施与长期协作。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: AI不只写报告了，现在开始进实验室一起做实验。

en-US.headlineFact: NASA and OpenAI join Genesis Mission; AI is becoming national research infrastructure
en-US.headlineView: Once AI enters national research systems, competition shifts from demos to data, compute, facilities and long-term collaboration.
en-US.headlineFull: NASA and OpenAI join Genesis Mission; AI is becoming national research infrastructure; Once AI enters national research systems, competition shifts from demos to data, compute, facilities and long-term collaboration.
en-US.intro: NASA and OpenAI separately announced support for the US Genesis Mission on July 22. NASA says the effort now spans more than 15 federal agencies; OpenAI will work with government, national labs, universities and researchers to connect frontier models with supercomputers, simulations and research facilities.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Once AI enters national research systems, competition shifts from demos to data, compute, facilities and long-term collaboration.
en-US.doudouQuote: AI is not just writing reports anymore; it is entering the lab to run experiments.

sources.title: NASA joins Genesis Mission to accelerate AI-driven discovery

zh-CN.headlineFact: WhatsApp新增iPad独立注册与PDF批注；一人公司的沟通栈继续轻量化
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司的效率，不只来自更强的AI，也来自减少每一次复制、下载和设备切换。
zh-CN.headlineFull: WhatsApp新增iPad独立注册与PDF批注；一人公司的沟通栈继续轻量化；一人公司的效率，不只来自更强的AI，也来自减少每一次复制、下载和设备切换。
zh-CN.intro: Meta于7月22日更新WhatsApp，用户可直接在iPad注册账户，并在网页和桌面端直接打开、标注PDF；CarPlay与Android Auto体验也同步升级。这并非专门面向小企业的产品，但对单人经营者而言，可减少设备切换和文档往返。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司的效率，不只来自更强的AI，也来自减少每一次复制、下载和设备切换。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 少开一个软件、少传一次文件，一天下来也能省下一大块时间。

en-US.headlineFact: WhatsApp adds standalone iPad sign-up and PDF markup; the one-person company stack gets lighter
en-US.headlineView: Solo-company efficiency comes not only from stronger AI, but from fewer copies, downloads and device switches.
en-US.headlineFull: WhatsApp adds standalone iPad sign-up and PDF markup; the one-person company stack gets lighter; Solo-company efficiency comes not only from stronger AI, but from fewer copies, downloads and device switches.
en-US.intro: Meta updated WhatsApp on July 22 so users can register directly on iPad and open and annotate PDFs on web and desktop. CarPlay and Android Auto also received updates. It is not a small-business product specifically, but it can reduce device switching and document handoffs for solo operators.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Solo-company efficiency comes not only from stronger AI, but from fewer copies, downloads and device switches.
en-US.doudouQuote: One fewer app and one fewer file transfer can save a surprising amount of a day.

sources.title: New WhatsApp features keep up with the way you actually live

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟正式质疑JD.com收购Ceconomy；跨境并购进入“补贴也要解释”阶段
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球化并未停止，但资本来源、融资条件和竞争公平性正在进入同一张审查表。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟正式质疑JD.com收购Ceconomy；跨境并购进入“补贴也要解释”阶段；全球化并未停止，但资本来源、融资条件和竞争公平性正在进入同一张审查表。
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟委员会向JD.com发出正式异议文件，质疑其约25亿美元收购德国电子零售商Ceconomy是否受外国补贴支持并扭曲竞争。JD.com可提出补救措施，欧盟最迟将于10月2日前决定是否放行；公司称这只是正常程序。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 全球化并未停止，但资本来源、融资条件和竞争公平性正在进入同一张审查表。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 以前只解释“为什么买”，现在还得解释“钱从哪里来”。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：跨境商业监管。

en-US.headlineFact: EU formally questions JD.com's Ceconomy takeover; cross-border deals enter the “explain the subsidy” era
en-US.headlineView: Global M&A has not stopped, but capital origins, financing terms and competitive fairness now share the same review table.
en-US.headlineFull: EU formally questions JD.com's Ceconomy takeover; cross-border deals enter the “explain the subsidy” era; Global M&A has not stopped, but capital origins, financing terms and competitive fairness now share the same review table.
en-US.intro: The European Commission sent JD.com formal objections over whether foreign subsidies may have supported its roughly $2.5 billion takeover of German electronics retailer Ceconomy and distorted competition. JD.com may offer remedies; the EU decision is due by October 2.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Global M&A has not stopped, but capital origins, financing terms and competitive fairness now share the same review table.
en-US.doudouQuote: Deals used to explain why to buy; now they must also explain where the money came from.

sources.title: Chinese e-commerce giant JD.com given notice of EU concerns over Ceconomy takeover

zh-CN.headlineFact: Nike收紧中国线上分销；品牌信任正压过渠道覆盖
zh-CN.headlineView: 渠道越多不一定越强；当价格、体验和信任失控时，覆盖面反而会稀释品牌。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Nike收紧中国线上分销；品牌信任正压过渠道覆盖；渠道越多不一定越强；当价格、体验和信任失控时，覆盖面反而会稀释品牌。
zh-CN.intro: Nike计划从明年1月起限制主要中国批发伙伴在线销售，其产品将集中在Nike官网、App及天猫、京东、抖音的官方品牌店。公司称要减少市场碎片化并恢复价格与体验控制；其大中华区最近一季销售额下降17%。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 渠道越多不一定越强；当价格、体验和信任失控时，覆盖面反而会稀释品牌。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 店铺铺得满屏，不代表顾客还知道哪一家才是真的。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：消费与零售。

en-US.headlineFact: Nike tightens online distribution in China; brand trust is outweighing channel reach
en-US.headlineView: More channels do not guarantee a stronger brand; when price, experience and trust slip out of control, wider reach can dilute it.
en-US.headlineFull: Nike tightens online distribution in China; brand trust is outweighing channel reach; More channels do not guarantee a stronger brand; when price, experience and trust slip out of control, wider reach can dilute it.
en-US.intro: Starting next January, key China wholesalers will stop selling Nike products online. Sales will focus on Nike’s site and app plus official stores on Tmall, JD.com and Douyin. Nike says the fragmented market needs tighter price and experience control; Greater China sales fell 17% in the latest quarter.
en-US.xiaziQuote: More channels do not guarantee a stronger brand; when price, experience and trust slip out of control, wider reach can dilute it.
en-US.doudouQuote: When listings fill every screen, customers stop knowing which store is real.

sources.title: Nike to tighten online sales in China amid cluttered marketplace

zh-CN.headlineFact: Research4Life运行25年覆盖120多国；知识可达性开始显现可量化回报
zh-CN.headlineView: 科研公平不只是赠送数据库权限，而是让更多地区真正进入发现、发表与临床合作网络。
zh-CN.headlineFull: Research4Life运行25年覆盖120多国；知识可达性开始显现可量化回报；科研公平不只是赠送数据库权限，而是让更多地区真正进入发现、发表与临床合作网络。
zh-CN.intro: WHO纪念Research4Life成立25周年。该项目为120多个中低收入国家的研究人员和医务工作者提供低价或免费科研资源。WHO援引独立研究称，项目相关国家论文发表量最高提升75%，国际临床试验参与度提高逾20%。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 科研公平不只是赠送数据库权限，而是让更多地区真正进入发现、发表与临床合作网络。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 知识的大门打开后，新的答案才可能从更多地方走出来。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：全球健康与知识公平。

en-US.headlineFact: Research4Life marks 25 years across 120+ countries; knowledge access is showing measurable returns
en-US.headlineView: Research equity is not merely database access; it lets more regions join networks of discovery, publishing and clinical collaboration.
en-US.headlineFull: Research4Life marks 25 years across 120+ countries; knowledge access is showing measurable returns; Research equity is not merely database access; it lets more regions join networks of discovery, publishing and clinical collaboration.
en-US.intro: WHO marks Research4Life’s 25th anniversary. The programme gives researchers and health workers in more than 120 low- and middle-income countries free or low-cost access to scientific resources. Independent studies cited by WHO link it to publication gains of up to 75% and over 20% more participation in international clinical trials.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Research equity is not merely database access; it lets more regions join networks of discovery, publishing and clinical collaboration.
en-US.doudouQuote: Open the door to knowledge, and new answers can emerge from more places.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 处方燃烧让巨杉存活率接近四倍；防火的关键正在前移
zh-CN.headlineView: 真正的韧性不是灾害来了以后反应更快，而是提前改变灾害发生时的条件。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 处方燃烧让巨杉存活率接近四倍；防火的关键正在前移；真正的韧性不是灾害来了以后反应更快，而是提前改变灾害发生时的条件。
zh-CN.intro: NASA资助的一项研究发现，在实施过处方燃烧管理的森林中，巨杉遭遇极端野火后的存活概率接近未管理区域的4倍。研究针对美国巨杉生态系统，说明通过提前清理可燃物，可能比火灾发生后单纯加强扑救更有效。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正的韧性不是灾害来了以后反应更快，而是提前改变灾害发生时的条件。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 有时候保护森林，不是完全不让它着火，而是让火烧得更聪明。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与生态韧性。

en-US.headlineFact: Prescribed burns bring giant-sequoia survival close to four times higher; wildfire prevention is moving upstream
en-US.headlineView: Real resilience is not reacting faster after disaster arrives; it is changing the conditions before disaster strikes.
en-US.headlineFull: Prescribed burns bring giant-sequoia survival close to four times higher; wildfire prevention is moving upstream; Real resilience is not reacting faster after disaster arrives; it is changing the conditions before disaster strikes.
en-US.intro: A NASA-funded study found that giant sequoias in forests managed with prescribed burns were nearly four times more likely to survive extreme wildfires than trees in unmanaged areas. In US giant-sequoia ecosystems, reducing fuel before a fire may work better than relying only on rescue afterward.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Real resilience is not reacting faster after disaster arrives; it is changing the conditions before disaster strikes.
en-US.doudouQuote: Sometimes protecting a forest means letting fire burn more intelligently, not banning it completely.

sources.title: NASA-funded study shows how controlled burns help sequoias survive wildfires

zh-CN.headlineFact: 日元跌至近40年低位、日本转为贸易逆差；能源冲击正在穿透进口账单
zh-CN.headlineView: 汇率不是屏幕上的抽象数字，它最终会进入能源、食品、制造和家庭消费的每一张账单。
zh-CN.headlineFull: 日元跌至近40年低位、日本转为贸易逆差；能源冲击正在穿透进口账单；汇率不是屏幕上的抽象数字，它最终会进入能源、食品、制造和家庭消费的每一张账单。
zh-CN.intro: 日本财务省数据显示，6月贸易逆差为4069亿日元，去年同期为顺差；进口额因油价和日元贬值增长25%至11.3万亿日元，出口增长19%至10.9万亿日元。日元一度跌至约163兑1美元，为1986年以来低位。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 汇率不是屏幕上的抽象数字，它最终会进入能源、食品、制造和家庭消费的每一张账单。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 钱包没出国，汇率也能自己跑进来。

en-US.headlineFact: The yen nears a 40-year low as Japan returns to a trade deficit; the energy shock is reaching import bills
en-US.headlineView: Exchange rates are not abstract numbers on a screen; they eventually flow into every bill for energy, food, manufacturing and household consumption.
en-US.headlineFull: The yen nears a 40-year low as Japan returns to a trade deficit; the energy shock is reaching import bills; Exchange rates are not abstract numbers on a screen; they eventually flow into every bill for energy, food, manufacturing and household consumption.
en-US.intro: Japan recorded a June trade deficit of 406.9 billion yen, reversing a surplus a year earlier. Imports rose 25% to 11.3 trillion yen as oil costs and a weaker currency lifted the bill, while exports rose 19% to 10.9 trillion yen. The yen briefly weakened to around 163 per dollar, its lowest level since 1986.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Exchange rates are not abstract numbers on a screen; they eventually flow into every bill for energy, food, manufacturing and household consumption.
en-US.doudouQuote: Your wallet never left home, but the exchange rate still found a way in.
